content.description:
Cardano Name Service (CNS) is a platform for social networking on the Cardano network, empowering users to create and manage secure social profiles on Cardano, with .ada domains acting as gateways to their digital identity.

The platform facilitates connections, enabling users to find friends, engage in activities, and expand their network with verifiable users. CNS also provides the ability to receive and share verifiable credentials for various achievements, all recorded immutably on Cardano. Built on a new technical innovation, CNS utilizes an advanced data structure to enhance the efficiency of data storage on Cardano, ensuring all information is stored on the blockchain in a decentralized manner without compromising security.
